description: List Indonesian statutes and executive instruments by type and year from the House of Representatives (DPR RI) legal register — Undang-Undang, Perpu, Peraturan Pemerintah, Peraturan Presiden, Keputusan Presiden, Instruksi Presiden, Peraturan DPR — with the DPR id needed by idn_statute_detail and a direct PDF link, optionally filtered by Indonesian title words. Use for "all Indonesian laws enacted in 2020", "presidential regulations of 2024 about energy".

query.description: Indonesian words that must all appear in the title, e.g. "mineral batubara". Optional.

type.description: One of: uu, perpu, pp, perpres, keppres, inpres, perdpr, peraturanbersama (default uu).

year.description: Four-digit year, e.g. "2020". Strongly recommended — without it DPR shows only its newest few.

name: idn_list_statutes
title: Idn List Statutes
